description.value: Beach Grove Cafe & Boutique is a combined cafe and lifestyle boutique in Delta's Beach Grove neighbourhood that has been operating since 2009. The boutique carries home decor, beauty and wellness products, women's clothing, jewellery, and artisan packaged foods, and also offers home styling services. The cafe component is not reflected on the business's current website, making it difficult to assess the food and beverage experience a visiting cyclist would encounter.
